text: A thick current carrying cable of radius \(R\) carries current \(I\) uniformly distributed across its cross-section. The variation of magnetic field \(B(r)\) due to the cable with the distance \(r\) from the axis of the cable is represented by

options.label: A
options.text: Graph (1): B increasing as a concave-up curve with r (B \(\propto r^2\)-like)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph (2): B increasing linearly with r throughout

options.label: C
options.text: Graph (3): B rising linearly up to r = R then falling as 1/r (hyperbola)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph (4): B rising and saturating (concave-down) with r

text: Which of the following graphs depicts the effect of substrate concentration on velocity of enzyme catalysed reaction?

options.label: A
options.text: A hyperbolic saturation curve: velocity of reaction rises with substrate concentration then levels off at \(V_{max}\)

options.label: B
options.text: A straight line: velocity of reaction increases linearly with substrate concentration up to \(V_{max}\)

options.label: C
options.text: A parabolic curve: velocity rises to \(V_{max}\) then declines with increasing substrate concentration

options.label: D
options.text: A decreasing curve: velocity of reaction declines from a high value as substrate concentration increases
